name: netlify
description: Connect Netlify to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Netlify MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Netlify to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with projects, deploys and request logs using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Netlify workspace.
Find anything in Netlify that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review projects, deploys and request logs in Netlify.
